# INTCO Medical

> > INTCO Medical is a leading manufacturer of disposable medical gloves and protective equipment, specializing in nitrile, vinyl, and synthetic latex gloves with FDA and CE certifications for healthcare, industrial, and life sciences applications.

INTCO Medical operates globally across Europe, Asia, Africa, and Oceania, maintaining rigorous quality standards including ASTM compliance and LCA Carbon Footprint Certifications. The company actively participates in international trade shows and engages in corporate social responsibility initiatives throughout China.
